C_BULK.derivation: Output capacitance sized for ripple voltage: ΔV = I_load / (f_sw × C). For 10A load, 250kHz resonant frequency, targeting < 100mV ripple: C = 10A / (250kHz × 0.1V) = 400µF minimum. Using 2× 1000µF = 2000µF for margin and lower ESR.
C_BULK.margin: 2000µF provides ripple ΔV ≈ 20mV (5× margin), ESR-limited ripple with 50mΩ ESR × 3A ripple current = 150mV additional. Total ripple < 200mV.
C_BULK.reference: TI SLUA559A eq. 4-3, output capacitor selection for LLC converters

C_HF.derivation: High-frequency ceramic capacitors parallel with electrolytics to reduce ESR and ESL at switching frequency. Total 6× 47µF = 282µF. X5R/X7R dielectric for stable capacitance over temperature and voltage.

inputs.derating: Ceramic caps at 12V on 25V rating retain ~85% capacitance

C_HF.margin: Effective HF capacitance ~240µF at 12V operating voltage. ESR of parallel ceramics << electrolytic ESR.
C_HF.reference: Standard LLC design practice, multiple parallel ceramics for low ESL

R_VSENSE.derivation: Isolation resistor for voltage sense tap. Creates high-impedance connection (>> capacitor ESR) to prevent feedback circuit from loading the output filter. Current through R_VSENSE: I = 12V / 1kΩ = 12mA negligible load.
R_VSENSE.margin: 1kΩ is standard value for voltage sense isolation, minimal impact on regulation accuracy
R_VSENSE.reference: General practice for isolated voltage sensing in power supplies

J_OUT_current_rating.derivation: Screw terminal KF128-5.08-2P rated for 10A continuous per LCSC C8465 specifications. Matched to maximum output current requirement.
J_OUT_current_rating.margin: Connector at rated current, no derating. Wire size (16 AWG) supports 13A continuous per NEC tables.
J_OUT_current_rating.reference: LCSC part C8465 datasheet, NEC wire ampacity tables
